label: Read a provision within its legal structure
explanation: The LRS treatment of statutory structure considers how neighboring provisions and the whole enactment bear on meaning. UCC § 2-207 separates formation, the treatment of additional terms, and contracts established by conduct into distinct subsections. That organization supplies a concrete comparison for reading legal text in context.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 269–304. Open assigned page 269.

comparisonLimits: Comparative study link, not a shared governing legal test.
